FM1_strings_scanned._note: Type-preserving: `&& c === '#'` after the quote check is TS2367 (no overlap) and core ts-jest type-checks. K11 reddens by mechanism: its $z sits inside a ''' long string.

FM3_iris_scanned._note: K1 reddens by mechanism: with IRIs not skipped, the # inside <…exo#Asset_label> opens a 'comment' that hides the real $who to the end of the line.

FM6_long_string_as_short._note: K7 stays green by mechanism: its long string holds two ESCAPED quotes, and read as a chain of short strings it closes at the same place. K11 reddens by mechanism: its $z sits inside a ''' long string.

FM8_long_escape_ignored._note: The review's X7b: an escaped quote before the closing triple quote ends the long string early.

FM9_lt_always_iri._note: The review's RS: `<` read as an IRI to the nearest `>` swallows `?s < $dayEnd) . ?e <…p>`.

FM10_single_quote_long_as_short._note: Review L5: only """ opens a long string; a ''' string with a bare quote inside ends early and the rest reads as tokens.
